prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1435; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the claimant in connection with the rear-end collision that occurred involving your insured. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and has begun a course of medical treatment that is ongoing. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and refrain from contacting our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide, in writing, the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, together with a certified declarations page confirming any additional coverage that may apply to this loss. We also ask that you confirm whether any excess or umbrella policies exist.

Please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and telematics records, dashcam footage, recorded statements, repair estimates, and any communications with third parties. Preservation of this material is required, and its loss or alteration may expose your insured and your company to sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response.
